subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Microgrids: Power Independence
description: Learn Microgrids: Power Independence in one minute.

hook.text: A military base, a campus, or a hospital can run its own mini power grid.

buildup.text: Microgrids combine local solar, batteries, and generators into a self-contained system.

discovery.text: They connect to the main grid normally but can island during outages.

twist.text: In Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria, microgrids were the only lights still on.

climax.text: Remote villages with no grid access leapfrog straight to solar microgrids.

punchline.text: Small grids don't replace the big one — they survive when it fails.

quiz.question: What makes a microgrid different from the main power grid?
options: It uses only renewable energy sources
It can disconnect and operate independently during main grid failures
It only provides power to residential buildings
